action_summary: This round wired the confinement substrate into the door and corrected the previous round's diagnosis with measurements. SEAM: canonical/runtime/confined_dispatch_v1.py + CONFINED_EFFECT_DECLARATIONS_V1.json (reviewed data: 11 capabilities declaring which bound argument is the verified effect) + a 9-line seam in run_adapter_locally: a declared capability runs its REAL adapter imported from the disposable clone with root=worktree, declared effects verified by sha256 inside the worktree, the host git status byte-identical after, and the SAME expectation check judging the result; every non-honorable shape returns None and the refusal stands. Measured 5/5 including end-to-end: python.source.symbols.index.ast runs against THIS repository, the clone indexes the clone, symbols_index.json verifies inside the worktree, the host never moves, dependency.executor=ADMITTED_CONFINEMENT_V1. CORRECTION: tracing the door with sys.settrace showed boundary.refuses_execution is NEVER consulted for the probe's confinement-refused goals -- the status is emitted by _serve_by_acting, the program-synthesis discovery fallback, which masks the compile failure underneath (the capability path never runs; refuses_execution for the symbols-index adapter is False -- it is not execution-classified at all). The probe re-run with the seam live measured door fates UNCHANGED (32 NOT_COMPILED / 3 EXECUTED / 3 ROUTED_ELSEWHERE): the wall for realistic advanced-coding sentences is the COMPILE LAYER, one layer earlier than the previous round claimed. The honest chain is now sentence->compile(FAIL for 32/38)->bind->confined dispatch (NEW, measured)->verified receipt. The previous doc's claim that the wall was 'refused for want of the substrate' is corrected here: the substrate was necessary but the compile layer is the binding constraint at the door. The guard suite (23/23) confirms every pinned refusal stands, including the compress-notes discovery refusal.
